example_type: Saved historical predictions and cached LLM responses; no new inference or API call in the demo.
snapshot_selection: Latest held-out test origin with maximum simultaneous station coverage and non-suspect observed PM10; predictions were not used to select the date.
scope: The examples use four stations present in the test period. Training schemas also include GR0463A, which has no samples in the final test period.
reviewed_examples: Edited with AI-assistant assistance; these are not unedited model completions or an independent human evaluation.
contract_comparison: Three report tasks, two output conditions, three repetitions: 18 original completions. Numeric-presence scores use the corrected punctuation-aware matcher.
input_data: The full original-value pollutant/weather archive, prepared matrices and model binaries are excluded from this package.
limitations: Historical replay, not live air-quality information.
One seed and a previously inspected historical period.
The raw-versus-processed comparison combines cleaning, features, imputation and training-sample selection.
A valid JSON structure is not a semantic or safety guarantee.
Intervals have imperfect observed coverage; their nominal 90% level is not a guarantee.
